scope: All tracked files at the audited commit; every text line scanned mechanically. External fact verification is limited to explicitly inspected primary pages.

findings.title: Official-source coverage is not external verification
findings.detail: Many inherited validators check URL domains and arithmetic. Those checks cannot establish that every cited value matches the official page. This session independently inspected only its own 62-game/38-player extracts plus the explicitly listed cross-checks.

findings.title: Partner player logs do not meet the strict league-source requirement
findings.detail: The newer pipeline identifies ESPN as a broadcast-partner fallback. Only leader lines and a small full-box sample are described as NBA-cross-checked; the remaining player rows are not independently verified against NBA official box scores. Do not label the entire player log official-NBA-verified.

findings.title: Assumed -110 prices are not observed sportsbook quotes
findings.detail: research/config.py fixes LEG_DECIMAL=1.9091. Returns using this constant are scenario results, not realized or officially quoted betting ROI. The inherited workspace discloses the assumption; it remains ineligible under this session’s official-price gate.

findings.title: Known team scoring discrepancies remain unresolved
findings.detail: scripts/verify_data.py explicitly permits DAL and ATL points-per-game differences between the transcribed game ledger and the official team table. A passing consistency suite therefore does not mean every source value agrees.

findings.title: Correlation is not a full joint ticket distribution
findings.detail: Pairwise correlation and failure to reject independence do not establish tail independence or an executable parlay edge. Actual joint outcomes and the quoted ticket price are required.

findings.title: Archived verification commands need a Git checkout
findings.detail: The inherited root verifier passed its data checks but failed a Git-diff reproducibility check in an archive without .git, and reported some namespaced pages unreachable from the root directory. These are recorded as audit findings, not silently treated as a clean pass. Local links in those pages can still resolve.

findings.title: NBA download restriction and automated bulk collection conflict
findings.detail: NBA FAQ says stats are not available for personal/academic download. Inherited automated NBA/ESPN collection needs a rights/access review before being treated as authorized. This session does not run or extend that collector.

findings.title: Compiled bytecode is tracked
findings.detail: Compiled __pycache__ files are present in the inherited repository. They are not primary evidence and should be removed by their owning session; this audit does not edit them.

findings.title: Shared board contains historical conflict markers
findings.detail: Historical merge markers remain in the shared board. They are preserved to avoid rewriting another session’s record; the current session’s task table and completion log are separate and explicit.

findings.title: Unverified does not mean zero
findings.detail: Missing odds, ROI, personalized prop lines and short-sample confidence intervals must remain null. This rule is enforced in the new workspace and checked across every generated HTML table row.

primary_crosschecks.subject: 2026-10-20 opening slate
primary_crosschecks.result: BOS 113–121 DET; PHI 106–100 NYK; OKC 116–104 SAS matched the inherited game rows.

primary_crosschecks.subject: 2025-26 standings snapshot
primary_crosschecks.result: Official page read: DET 60–22, BOS 56–26, OKC 64–18. The page is season-specific; current-season URL alone is not a historical snapshot.

primary_crosschecks.subject: 2026-27 team scoring snapshot
primary_crosschecks.result: Official page read: MEM 6 GP, 121.2 PPG, +15.2; HOU 7 GP, 120.7 PPG, +12.4; PHI 7 GP, 108.7 PPG, +3.9 matched inherited rows.

limitations: No claim that every inherited numeric row was externally re-fetched.
GitHub links identify the repository record, not an independent league source.
Peer-owned files were not edited; requests and findings are logged for review.
